# logging-v1alpha1_destination_list (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `namespace` (String) the namespace scope in which to operate

### Optional

- `fields` (String) a comma-separated list of resource fields to fetch/return.  If unspecified, all fields are fetched.  If empty, only key-fields are fetched.
- `filter` (String) an EQL "where" expression that will be used to filter the set of resources returned.
- `label_selector` (String) A label selector string to filter the results based on resource labels. If specified multiple times, the union of resources which satisfy a label-selector will be returned.
- `labelselector` (String) Deprecated: a label selector string to filter the results based on CR labels

### Read-Only

- `api_version` (String)
- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `kind` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--items--spec--file"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.spec.file`

Read-Only:

- `location` (String) Path to location where log files are written. Refer to the documentation for default and allowed values.


<a id="nestedatt--items--spec--rotation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.spec.rotation`

Read-Only:

- `max_entries` (Number) Maximum number of log entries kept in the in-memory buffer. Only supported on SR OS.
- `max_size_megabytes` (Number) Maximum size of the in-memory buffer, in megabytes. Only supported on SR Linux.
- `rollover_interval_minutes` (Number) Interval, in minutes, at which the current log file is closed and a new one is started. Only supported on SR OS.
- `rollover_size_megabytes` (Number) File size, in megabytes, at which the current log file is closed and a new one is started. Only supported on SR Linux.
- `rotation_limit` (Number) Number of rolled-over log files to keep before the oldest is discarded.


<a id="nestedatt--items--spec--syslog"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.spec.syslog`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) Address of the syslog server: an IPv4 address, IPv6 address, or DNS name (FQDN).
- `protocol` (String) Transport protocol used to send syslog messages.
- `remote_port` (Number) Remote port on the syslog server.
- `router` (String) Name of the Router custom resource used to reach the syslog server.
- `router_kind` (String) Router kind used to reach the syslog server.
- `tls_profile` (String) Name of the TLS profile used when syslog is sent over TLS.
